eventHandlers.description: All registered event handlers on this EventSource that should be serialized with state.

nonSerializableEventHandlers.description: All registered event handlers on this EventSource that should NOT be serialized with state.

title:
Type that can trigger {@link EventWithSource}. Manages callback registration and invokes appropriate callbacks when
specific instances of the {@link EventWithSource} are triggered.

Although the name may be confusing, types mixing EventSource represent not just the source or trigger of the event
but also the listener, registering/deregistering with the #on/#off methods.
The reason for this is because we want the listeners to be stored on the metadata of the event that it's emitting.
name: EventSource
